english.title: Cause use of vehicle with dangerous mascot etc

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: ROAD VEHICLES CONSTRUCTION AND USE REGULATIONS 1986

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), to use on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on which was carried

(A)_[a mascot,]_
(B)_[an emblem,]_
(C)_[an ornamental object,]_

in such a position that it was likely to strike a person with whom the vehicle might collide
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 53(1) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Regulation 53(1) only applies to vehicles first used on or after 1.10.1937.
(ii) Mascots not liable to cause injury to such a person as mentioned above by virtue of projections are excepted.
(iii) Instead of complying with regulation 53(1), the vehicle may comply with Community Directive 74/483 or 79/488 or ECE Regulation 26.01.
(iv) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(v) See also offence wordings: H2573 and H3065.
english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) which carried **(..DESCRIBE OBJECT AND ITS POSITION..). It was in such a position on the vehicle that it was likely to strike a person with whom the vehicle might collide.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
